<b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-size: 2em;">Eleventh Stratagem</span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><b><span style="font-size: x-large;"><br /></span></b></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><b style="color: #333333;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: x-large;"><span lang="zh-CN">李代桃僵</span></span></b></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(lǐ
dài táo jiāng)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Sacrifice
the Plum Tree to Preserve the Peach Tree</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">A
long-term objective may sometimes call for the sacrifice of certain
short-term objectives. This is also referred to as the "scapegoat"
strategy, whereby the suffering of a few might ensure that the rest
do not.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">Cao
Cao, while under a siege in the Three Kingdoms Period (220-280 A.D.),
demonstrated this strategy when his supplies ran low. He called in
the supply captain and ordered him to water down the rice and grain.
When the soldiers started to complain, Cao ordered that the captain
be killed, and then explained to his troops that the captain had been
stealing the supplies and selling them to the enemy. This raised the
army's morale and they were victorious for a few more days [29].</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Sacrifice
the Plum Tree to Preserve the Peach Tree</span></i></span> is
associated with the 39th hexagram, <i>Water over Mountain</i>. Danger
ahead is symbolized by Water, and obstruction from behind by
Mountain. This is meant to suggest a situation in which the direct
route cannot lead to success, where one must hold back, wait, even
lose the battle, to prevail in the long term. Another interpretation
that the Mountain waits patiently rather than plunging ahead, and
eventually combines with the adaptability of water, allowing for
small sacrifices to be made for the good of the larger goals at hand
[1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>


	
	
	
	

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">

<div dir="ltr" id="Section63" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">1) I: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我以为你三点会来。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp; II: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">对不起，我来晚了，因为我的汽车</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;有问题。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">2)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你有没有决定去哪里上学？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">没有，我还没有决定。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">3)</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large; color: #0047AB !important;">李子好吃，桃子也好吃。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">4)</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large; color: #0047AB !important;">橙汁没有了，可以用橙子来代替吗？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">5)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">老板为什么很生气？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">因为张涛昨天晚上忘记锁门了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">6)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">小张为什么很难过？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">因为他忘记锁车门，有人偷了他汽</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;车里所有的东西。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br />
    7)<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她把苹果全部都吃完了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.:
	She ate all of the apple.</span></p><br>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">8)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">现在几点了？</span></span>|
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">现在什么时候？</span></span></span></p><br>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">   
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">现在四点半。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br>9)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们今天只用上半天班。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.:
	Today we only have to work half of</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"> </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">the day.</span></p><br>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">10)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">超市几点开门？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">上午九点开门。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">11)</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-family: times;"><span style="font-size: large; color: #0047AB !important;">今天太冷了，我要冻僵了。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">12)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">哪一双鞋便宜？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; A: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">黑色的那双比咖啡色的便宜。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">13)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">小王比我年轻，也比我高。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">14)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">今天的雨下得比昨天的大，云比昨天的</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;少。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">15)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里的人比那里的多，但是汽车比那里</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;的少。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">16)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">一天有二十四个小时，一个小时有六十</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;分钟。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">17)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我喜欢全部的老师，除了他。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">18)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">别下水，除非你会游泳。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">19)
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个菜不好吃，吃另一个吧。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">20</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)
	</span></span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="text-decoration: none;"><span lang="zh-CN">她今天不太高兴，因为昨晚没睡好。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-10-hide-knife.html">Previous Chapter</a>


</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
